description: This file contains a comprehensive suite of tests for the Litellm project, specifically targeting Gemini models and their integrations such as message transformation, caching, error handling, image generation, and parameter mapping. It verifies functionality, edge cases, and correct exception raising across multiple Gemini model variants and features.
